gatewaysPage.subtitle: PLC connections and the drivers that read them.
gatewaysPage.name: Gateway name
gatewaysPage.poller_all_box: No edge box assigned: polled by “{{name}}”
gatewaysPage.who_polls_hint: Assign it to an edge box only if the server cannot reach this PLC. From then on the box polls it and the server stops: never two, never none.
gatewaysPage.transport_rtuovertcp: RTU over TCP: serial gateway in transparent mode
gatewaysPage.transport_hint: RTU over TCP looks like TCP on the wire and carries RTU framing inside. Choosing plain TCP for one gives a socket that opens and then answers nothing.
gatewaysPage.serial_device_hint: The port on the machine running the driver: /dev/ttyUSB0 on Linux, COM3 on Windows. It must be passed through to the driver container.
gatewaysPage.zero_based_hint: Enable if your PLC documentation starts addresses from 0
gatewaysPage.addr_one: Addresses use the standard Modbus convention (1-based).
gatewaysPage.mqtt_external: Optionally subscribe to a customer-owned external broker (below).
gatewaysPage.mqtt_json_before: For JSON payloads use the tag's
gatewaysPage.mqtt_json_after: field to extract a single value.
gatewaysPage.broker_hint_before: Leave the host empty to use OpenEdge's internal broker (the PLC publishes straight to us). Set host and port when the PLCs publish to
gatewaysPage.broker_hint_after: broker and OpenEdge should connect to it.
gatewaysPage.cert_hint_before: Paths must be valid inside the
gatewaysPage.opcua_desc: Connects to an OPC UA server and reads the selected nodes at the configured scan rate.
gatewaysPage.opcua_step1: Enter the server's OPC UA endpoint URL
gatewaysPage.opcua_step2_after: in the Tags page to discover and add nodes

orgInfra.download_started_desc: The package for the new edge box is downloading
orgInfra.title: Infrastructure: {{name}}
orgInfra.subtitle: Edge boxes, API keys, invites, webhooks and SSO for this organization.
orgInfra.who_polls_desc: Each gateway is polled by the edge box it is assigned to, or by the server. Never two, never none.
orgInfra.install_box_desc: Only needed next to PLCs the server cannot reach. The ZIP contains docker-compose, the credentials and the install scripts for Linux and Windows. The box starts with no gateways: assign its gateways afterwards from the Gateways page.
orgInfra.key_save_now: Save this key now: it will not be shown again
orgInfra.keys_empty: No active API keys. Create one so the edge manager can authenticate.
orgInfra.invite_link_hint: The link expires in 7 days. Send it to the invited person: they will choose their own password.
orgInfra.invite_footer: The invite link lets the recipient create their own account in this organization. Each link can be used once and expires after 7 days.
orgInfra.wh_secret_title: Webhook signing secret: save it now
orgInfra.wh_secret_hint_after: header on incoming requests. It won't be shown again.
orgInfra.wh_empty: No webhooks configured. Add one to send events to external systems.
orgInfra.sso_intro: Set up Google or Microsoft (Azure AD) single sign-on so people can log in with their corporate credentials.
orgInfra.sso_secret_keep: (leave blank to keep the current one)
orgInfra.sso_domain_placeholder: company.com: detects the organization from the login email

organizationsPage.subtitle: Manage organizations (separate customers or plants), install edge boxes and invite people.
organizationsPage.create_desc: Each organization is isolated from the others: it has its own edge boxes, users and data.
organizationsPage.name: Organization name

infrastructurePage.subtitle: All gateways, where they are and whether they are reachable

edgeBoxes.removed_desc: Its key is revoked and its gateways go back to the server.
edgeBoxes.server_polls_one: Polls {{count}} gateway directly: the one you have not assigned to any edge box.
edgeBoxes.server_polls_other: Polls {{count}} gateways directly: the ones you have not assigned to any edge box.
edgeBoxes.server_no_poll: Does not poll any PLC (no driver-manager running on the server, typical of a cloud server).
edgeBoxes.unpolled_one: {{count}} gateway is not polled by anyone.
edgeBoxes.unpolled_other: {{count}} gateways are not polled by anyone.
edgeBoxes.unpolled_hint: Assign them to an edge box from the Gateways page, or set an edge box to “All unassigned too”.
edgeBoxes.empty: No edge boxes installed. You don't need one if the server reaches every PLC: put an edge box only next to PLCs the server cannot reach.
edgeBoxes.scope_all_hint: “All unassigned too” is for when the server is in the cloud and polls nothing: only one edge box per organization can have it.

profilePage.title: My profile
profilePage.subtitle: Your account details, password and two-factor authentication
profilePage.mfa_intro: Protect your account with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy…): at login you will also be asked for a code.
profilePage.mfa_scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the first code here to turn it on.
profilePage.mfa_manual_key: Manual key (if you cannot scan the QR code)
profilePage.mfa_disable_hint: To turn off two-factor authentication, enter your current password.

connectedApps.subtitle: Applications you have allowed to access OpenEdge on your behalf. Each one acts with your identity, limited to what you approved.
connectedApps.empty: No connected applications. When you authorize one, it shows up here and you can remove its access from this page.
connectedApps.confirm_desc1: The application will no longer be able to renew its access and will have to ask for your authorization again.
connectedApps.confirm_desc2: The token it already holds stays valid until it expires, one hour at most: it is signed and cannot be recalled. If the application is compromised, change your password too.
